name: Madama Butterfly – Opera with a Difference
description: Giacomo Puccini's Madama Butterfly reimagined and performed at Kulturhaus Spandau in an unconventional interpretation. Described as 'retold, relived,' this production suggests a contemporary reworking of the classic opera that challenges traditional staging. The Spandau venue situates high culture in a district often overlooked in Berlin's cultural map, questioning assumptions about where opera belongs.
